panels.description: Tokens sent per main-thread request (input + cache), per session. Drops = auto-compact

targets.expr: max_over_time({job="claude-code"} | json | attributes_event_name="api_request" | attributes_session_id=~"$session" | label_format session=`{{ trunc 8 .attributes_session_id }}` | attributes_query_source="repl_main_thread" | label_format ctx=`{{ addf .attributes_input_tokens (addf .attributes_cache_read_tokens .attributes_cache_creation_tokens) }}` | unwrap ctx | __error__="" [$__interval]) by (session)
